startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to start crawling from. The crawler follows same-site links from here (breadth-first) up to Max pages / Max depth.

maxPages.title: Max pages per run
maxPages.description: Hard cap on pages fetched and returned. Controls total cost.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: 0 scrapes only the start URLs, 1 adds pages they link to, and so on.

sameDomainOnly.title: Stay on the same domain
sameDomainOnly.description: Only follow links on the same domain as the start URL (subdomains included).

includePatterns.title: Include URL patterns
includePatterns.description: If set, only URLs containing at least one of these substrings are crawled (start URLs are always fetched). Example: /docs/

excludePatterns.title: Exclude URL patterns
excludePatterns.description: URLs containing any of these substrings are skipped. Example: /changelog/

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Format of the extracted page content.

useSitemap.title: Discover pages from sitemap.xml
useSitemap.description: Also seed the crawl with URLs from the site's sitemap.xml (subject to the same filters and caps).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most sites work without any proxy. Enable datacenter proxy only if your target blocks direct requests.
